standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, chum, fancy buyin' some designer jewellery? They've come all the way from Ardougne! Most pukka!

standard-dialogue.player: Erm, no. I'm all set, thanks.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player is on a free-to-play world:

steps.npc: Okay, chum, would you like me to show you the very latest potion prices?
Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!

steps.player: So what do you have to sell?

steps.npc: Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know, business being so well and cushie.

steps.player: You don't really look like you're being so successful.

steps.npc: You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!

steps.player: You conveniently have a response for everything.

steps.npc: That's the Ardougne way, my friend.

options.text: Can you show me the prices for potions?

steps.player: Can you show me the prices for potions?

steps.target: Bob Barter (herbs){{!}}Grand Exchange: Herbs and Potions

standard-dialogue.text: If the player is on a members world:

steps.npc: Okay, chum, so what can I do for you? I can tell you the very latest herb & potion prices, or perhaps I could help you decant your potions.
Why, I'm Bob! Your friendly seller of smashin' goods!

steps.player: So what do you have to sell?

steps.npc: Oh, not much at the moment. Cuz, ya know, business being so well and cushie.

steps.player: You don't really look like you're being so successful.

steps.npc: You plonka! It's all a show, innit! If I let people knows I'm in good business they'll want a share of the moolah!

steps.player: You conveniently have a response for everything.

steps.npc: That's the Ardougne way, my friend.

options.text: Can you show me the prices for herbs and potions?

steps.player: Can you show me the prices for herbs and potions?

steps.target: Bob Barter (herbs){{!}}Grand Exchange: Herbs and Potions

options.text: Can you decant things for me?

steps.player: Can you decant things for me?

steps.npc: Let's see what you have...

steps.text: If the player can't fit spare spare containers in their inventory:

steps.npc: You're a bit short of inventory space.

steps.text: If the player cannot afford spare containers:

steps.npc: You're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost {{#expr:{{GEP|vial}}+2}} coins each and cups cost {{#expr:{{GEP|empty cup}}+2}} coins each.

steps.text: If the player can only afford a few containers:

steps.npc: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost {{#expr:{{GEP|vial}}+2}} coins each and cups cost {{#expr:{{GEP|empty cup}}+2}} coins each.

steps.text: If the player can afford all spare containers:

steps.npc: There, all done.
Two plus two is four, minus one that's three...

decanting-nothing-decantable.npc: I don't think you've got anything that I can decant.

decanting-trying-to-decant-in-free-to-pl.npc: Sorry, mate, you'll have to come back later for that.

steps.npc: Please, please, please work.
I'm in the money!
I could have sworn that would have worked.
Now what should I buy?
Hope this item sells well.
